variant_traits: swarm of many tiny natural bats

visual_overrides.core_identity: A readable swarm of ordinary bats moving as one turbulent mass while individual bat anatomy remains visible.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Many small bat silhouettes arranged in a clear directional spiral or funnel with open gaps between groups.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Repeated small natural bat bodies in varied wing positions with no oversized leader creature.
visual_overrides.surface: Minimal fur and wing detail to prevent visual noise.
